25G.name: Integrated controlled development evaluation / freeze
25G.deliverable: comparator + ablation evaluation report and freeze

reading_A_25F_constructs_25G_evaluates.claim: The module plan gives 25F the deliverable "S_omega + ROI-weighted fusion" and gives 25G the deliverable "comparator + ablation evaluation report and freeze", with 25G starting after 25E and 25F. Under this reading Phase25F CONSTRUCTS S_omega and the C9 policy, while the A7-vs-A8 comparative ablation evaluation belongs to Phase25G.

reading_B_25F_owns_C9_evaluation.claim: The Phase25E->25F handoff schema lists "C9 post-safety (S_omega) comparator" under phase25f_scope, and the Phase25E comparator direction contract marks C9 "Phase25F only", which could be read as Phase25F owning the C9 comparison.

recommended_ruling: Phase25F constructs S_omega + ROI-weighted fusion and may compute C9 policy artifacts on ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT, but the A7-vs-A8 (C8-vs-C9) comparative ablation evaluation and report are owned by Phase25G per the frozen module plan. A supervisor ruling is required to confirm before any A7/A8 evaluation.
